title: Request IDs propagate only when they match the safe charset and length
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag replacing a short but harmless-looking ID like 'abc123' as breaking trace correlation. The acceptance rule is a stated minimum length of 8: shorter values collide too easily and are cheap to forge into log searches, so the resolver regenerates rather than propagating a value outside the documented pattern.
